parsed.notes: Leverage Test is expressed as a percentage (debt-to-capital style), not a multiple: 21.9% actual vs 60% maximum. The Consolidated Tangible Net Worth covenant is a dollar minimum and is not a ratio, so it is not listed: actual $3,000,036 thousand vs required $2,279,702 thousand. The homebuilding debt-to-capital ratios (25.9% / 25.0%) are the company's own non-GAAP measures and are excluded. SOFR spread grids based on the leverage ratio only set pricing and are also excluded. The company states it was in compliance at September 30, 2026.
